svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut a 45 x 56 mm piece of perfboard; file the edges smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.2 mm holes, 3.5 mm in from the left edge, 3 mm from the right,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm in from the front and back edges (38.5 x 50 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left part: two 20-pin header sockets 19.4 mm apart (centre to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre), 51 mm long, for the controller board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right part: the 3.5 mm jack for the CT facing the right end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 5 V and probe screw terminals, the button, and the LED

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm right of the box centre and 20 mm toward the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Interface circuit as the wiring diagram: 1.50 V bias divider and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: filter for the CT, series resistor and clamp diodes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on four 5 mm hex stand-offs screwed to the box floor;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the board stays 4 mm clear of the right gland nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: continuity and no shorts before the controller goes in.
